$comment: Fully strict contract (D-01) for dnallm-mark/data/n_audit.json — the published N-frequency / non-ACGT census artifact (F7 Q2, REV-07; produced offline by script/audit_n_frequencies.py, a LOCAL maintainer step over gitignored datasets — never part of `make data`, never run in CI, so NOT drift-gated). Root maps EVERY unified-registry task (50 keys) to its audit: present tasks carry per-split censuses (rows, total sequence chars, non-ACGT char total excluding the '|' separator, rows containing non-ACGT chars, per-character counts, and survivor counts under BOTH pipeline charset classes — strict 'ACGTacgt|' and N-tolerant 'ACGTNacgtn|' at minl 0 / maxl 10010, mirroring run_finetune.py:832-839 exactly) plus unified_eval_n = min over the per-class test survivor counts (F7 Q1 — the strictest class governs); missing tasks (the 7 GUE dirs pending re-extraction) carry missing=true with null splits/unified_eval_n — explicit missing rows, never silent absences or zero-filled counts. Emission is deterministic (sorted iteration, sort_keys, no clock), so a committed file validates forever until the inputs change.
